description: Negative control: the cumulative-deposit question is answered by guessing and the case is marked ready. Structurally valid (it covers AC-4), so only the scenario reference catches it.

analysis.summary: Tier configuration limits, ordering validation, highest-tier-only award and activation guard. Unclear whether tiers are reached per deposit or cumulatively.

acceptance_criteria.text: A tiered promotion has between 1 and 5 tiers.
Each tier defines a minimum qualifying deposit and a bonus percentage from 1 to 200.
Tier minimum deposits must be strictly increasing; saving tiers that are not in increasing order is rejected with a validation error.
A player who qualifies for several tiers receives the bonus of the highest tier reached only.
A tiered promotion cannot be activated while it has no tiers.

findings.text: Is the tier reached evaluated per single deposit or on the cumulative deposits made during the promotion period?
Is there a maximum bonus amount per tier?
Can tiers be edited after activation, and what happens to bonuses already granted?

risks.title: Wrong tier awarded
risks.description: A player receives the bonus of a lower tier or of several tiers.

risks.title: Invalid configuration saved
risks.description: Out-of-range or unordered tiers are stored and break bonus calculation.

test_cases.title: Tiered promotion saves with 1 and with 5 tiers
test_cases.objective: AC-1 lower and upper boundary of the tier count.
preconditions: A promotion manager is signed in to the promotion editor

steps.action: Create a tiered promotion with 1 tier (min deposit 10, bonus 50) and save.
steps.expected_result: The promotion is saved with exactly 1 tier.

steps.action: Add tiers until there are 5 (min deposits 10, 20, 30, 40, 50) and save.
steps.expected_result: The promotion is saved with exactly 5 tiers.

test_cases.title: A sixth tier is never stored
preconditions: A promotion manager is signed in to the promotion editor

steps.action: Open a tiered promotion with 5 tiers and try to add a sixth tier with min deposit 60.
steps.expected_result: After saving and reopening, the promotion still has 5 tiers.

test_cases.title: Bonus percentages 1 and 200 are accepted
test_cases.objective: AC-2 boundaries of the bonus percentage.
preconditions: A promotion manager is signed in to the promotion editor

steps.action: Set tier 1 bonus to 1 percent and tier 2 bonus to 200 percent and save.
steps.expected_result: The promotion is saved and shows 1 and 200 percent.

test_cases.title: Bonus percentages 0 and 201 are never stored
test_cases.objective: AC-2 invalid partitions just outside the range.
preconditions: A promotion manager is signed in to the promotion editor

steps.action: Set a tier bonus to 0 percent and save.
steps.expected_result: The bonus percentage 0 is not stored; the tier keeps its previous value.

steps.action: Set a tier bonus to 201 percent and save.
steps.expected_result: The bonus percentage 201 is not stored; the tier keeps its previous value.

test_cases.title: Tiers in decreasing order are rejected with a validation error
preconditions: A promotion manager is signed in to the promotion editor

steps.action: Configure tier 1 min deposit 50 and tier 2 min deposit 20 and save.
steps.expected_result: Saving is rejected with a validation error and the tiers are not stored.

test_cases.title: Two tiers with the same minimum deposit are rejected
preconditions: A promotion manager is signed in to the promotion editor

steps.action: Configure tier 1 and tier 2 both with min deposit 20 and save.
steps.expected_result: Saving is rejected with a validation error and the tiers are not stored.

test_cases.title: A single deposit reaching tier 2 of 3 grants only the tier 2 bonus
test_cases.objective: AC-4 holds whether tiers are per deposit or cumulative: one deposit only.

steps.action: As a player with no earlier deposits in the period, deposit 25 into a promotion with tiers 10/50%, 20/100%, 30/150%.
steps.expected_result: The player receives a 100 percent bonus (25) and no other tier bonus.

test_cases.title: Two deposits whose sum reaches tier 3
test_cases.objective: AC-4 with cumulative deposits; depends on F-1 (per deposit or cumulative).

steps.action: As a player, deposit 15 and then 15 into a promotion with tiers 10/50%, 20/100%, 30/150%.
steps.expected_result: The player receives the tier 3 bonus of 150 percent (45).

test_cases.title: Activation is refused without tiers and allowed after adding one
test_cases.objective: AC-5 activation guard as a state transition.
preconditions: A promotion manager is signed in to the promotion editor

steps.action: Try to activate a tiered promotion that has no tiers.
steps.expected_result: The promotion stays in Draft status.

steps.action: Add one tier (min deposit 10, bonus 50) and activate again.
steps.expected_result: The promotion moves to Active status.
